title: Multi-level Encoder with Global Topic for Task-oriented Dialogue Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29097v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task-oriented dialogue summarization aims to automatically extract key information to generate domain summaries to improve service efficiency and quality. Task-oriented dialogue is inherently logical and surrounds specific topic. How to effectively capture the dialogue topic and the most salient information becomes one of the major challenges of this task. In this paper, we propose a task-oriented dialogue summarization model utilizing a multi-level encoder with global topic (MLEGT). This model discovers temporal and spatial dependencies through a multi-level encoder, while simultaneously obtaining a simple yet effective global topic in the process of graph construction. It not only captures the crucial details but also breaks the long-range limit and discover the intrinsic structure across the dialogue. translated_title: 基于全局主题的多级编码器面向任务型对话摘要生成
translated_abstract: 面向任务的对话摘要旨在自动提取关键信息以生成领域摘要，从而提高服务效率和质量。面向任务的对话具有内在的逻辑性，并围绕特定主题展开。如何有效捕捉对话主题和最突出的信息成为该任务的主要挑战之一。在本文中，我们提出了一种利用带全局主题的多级编码器的面向任务对话摘要模型。该模型通过多级编码器发现时间和空间依赖关系，同时在图构建过程中获得一个简单而有效的全局主题。它不仅捕捉关键细节，还突破了长距离限制，并发现对话中的内在结构。然后，在摘要生成器中加入了全局主题引导的指针机制，以捕捉被忽略但重要的信息。
tldr: 该论文提出MLEGT模型，通过带全局主题的多级编码器捕捉对话的时序与空间依赖关系及全局主题信息，并结合全局主题引导的指针机制来生成更准确的面向任务对话摘要。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MLEGT, a task-oriented dialogue summarization model that leverages a multi-level encoder with global topic to capture temporal-spatial dependencies and intrinsic dialogue structure, enhanced by a global topic guided pointer mechanism for more accurate summaries.
